heading_path: Part 39 Registration of a Trade Mark
chunks.text: Trade Marks Act 1995 Trade Mark Regulations 1995 Registration fees are applicable for applications lodged prior to Monday 10 October 2016. Reg 21.22 provides that the fee payable for the registration of a trade mark is that specified in the fee schedule at the time that the fee is paid. The applicant is advised of the current fee at the time of notification of acceptance. The procedures for the processing of a request for registration that is not accompanied by a fee, or for which the fee is underpaid, are outlined in Part 4 of this manual. Part 4 Fees
